visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left (Birth): A long, slender larva (Water Tiger) emerging from a submerged plant stem; Top-Right (Dining): The beetle tackling a small tadpole or fish fry; Bottom-Left (Sleeping/Resting): The beetle hanging upside down at the surface, 'recharging' its air supply; Bottom-Right (Playing/Social): Several beetles 'racing' through a forest of underwater plants.
visual_logic.style_notes: Focus on the 'Water Tiger' larva in the birth quadrant—it should look like a miniature, fierce dragon to contrast with the sleek adult.
